short: An alternative upper bound on the mean count

lean.name: Formalism.RankGapBounds.WeightedMeanData.Data.MeanBoundSecondForm
lean.plain: An alternative upper bound on the mean count
lean.note: This proposition bounds the mean of the weighted prime-power count by the mean of its main term plus an explicit error built from the lattice and slope estimates. It is the second form of the mean bound and sits outside the final dependency cone.
